_comment: Library of known handshakes for automatic search (gamepad-remapd handshake-probe, the button on testpage). The format is read by logic/handshake_lib.py. WARNING: this file was RESTORED by hand after an accidental overwrite: the schema is taken from the loader, the bytes and order from tests/test_handshake_probe.py and the SDL code (src/joystick/hidapi, main branch). If you have an earlier copy, compare them. The program does not invent bytes: it only tries what is written here. scope: any = safe for anyone (an empty step / read-only), vendor = matched by VID (and usage page), opt-in = a third-party vendor, only in a broad search. Put your own candidates in <config>/handshakes/*.json.

candidates.name: No handshake (listen only)
candidates.source: baseline case: the device may send reports on its own

candidates.name: Flydigi V1 (2.4 GHz receiver, vendor interface 2): GET_INFO
candidates.source: SDL SDL_hidapi_flydigi.c (V1, InitControllerV1); verified on Direwolf 3

candidates.name: 8BitDo: read feature report 0x06 (enables the extended mode)
8BitDo Ultimate 3: read feature report 0x30
candidates.source: SDL SDL_hidapi_8bitdo.c (InitDevice, Ultimate3 branch: ReadFeatureReport 0x30). Read-only

candidates.name: Flydigi V2 (Vader 4/5 Pro, Apex 5/6): GET_INFO, GET_STATUS, ACQUIRE
candidates.source: SDL SDL_hidapi_flydigi.c (V2: SendInfoRequest, SendStatusRequest, SendAcquireRequest). SDL repeats acquire every 30 s (heartbeat) — the daemon cannot do such a step yet

candidates.name: Nintendo Switch Pro (USB): handshake 80 02/03/02/04 and report mode 0x30
candidates.source: SDL SDL_hidapi_switch.c (USB-handshake, SetInputReportMode 0x30). Restored from memory: check the bytes of the last step against the SDL code
